name: Lever-operated switch
summary: A lever-operated switch changes contact state through a manually operated lever.
description: A lever-operated switch changes contact state through a manually operated lever. The lever's travel, stable positions and return behaviour are part of the operator schedule.
readingNotes: Compare the contact schedule to each lever position.
